crop.notes: Whole item, top of the right column on page 7.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Patrick Sullivan and Charles Dempsey picked a fight with Tom Allen in his saloon and ended up badly bruised at the Dispensary. Judge Peabody fined them $200 and $50 for disturbing the peace.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Thursday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, November 21, 1895, page 7.

facts.fact: Patrick Sullivan and Charles Dempsey picked a fight with Allen in his saloon and were beaten; Judge Peabody fined Sullivan $200 and Dempsey $50 for disturbing the peace

notes: The fight was Tuesday night (Nov. 19); the fines were Thursday morning (Nov. 21). The current summary calls the men 'drunks'; the paper says they 'had hallucinations'.
